meta.title: Lesson 19: Explain a Number
meta.title_zh: 第 19 课：解释一个数字

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: My manager asks about the five percent growth. I answer with a complete sentence. Sales grew five percent from last year. I also say where the number comes from. A number is stronger when people can check it.
segments.tts: My manager asks about the five percent growth. I answer with a complete sentence. Sales grew five percent from last year. I also say where the number comes from. A number is stronger when people can check it.
segments.zh: 经理问我百分之五的增长。我用完整句子回答：销售额比去年增长百分之五。我还说明数字来自哪里。一个可以被检查的数字更有说服力。讲解：complete=完整的，from last year=与去年相比，stronger=更有说服力。

segments.en: She asks if the growth is real or caused by a one-time event. I check the notes. One large order made this quarter special. I add this limit to the explanation. Context changes the meaning of a number.
segments.tts: She asks if the growth is real or caused by a one-time event. I check the notes. One large order made this quarter special. I add this limit to the explanation. Context changes the meaning of a number.
segments.zh: 她问增长是真实的，还是一次性事件造成的。我检查记录，发现一笔大订单让这个季度很特殊。我把这个限制补进解释。上下文会改变数字的含义。讲解：one-time=一次性的，quarter=季度，limit=限制，context=上下文。

segments.en: I do not need a long speech. I need a clear number, a source, and one important limit. This is enough for a useful update. Short evidence is easier for a busy team to remember.
segments.tts: I do not need a long speech. I need a clear number, a source, and one important limit. This is enough for a useful update. Short evidence is easier for a busy team to remember.
segments.zh: 我不需要一大段演讲，只需要一个清楚的数字、一个来源和一个重要限制。这样就足够做出有用的更新。简短的证据更容易让忙碌的团队记住。讲解：speech=演讲，limit=限制，update=更新，busy=忙碌的。

chunks.eg: Say where the number comes from.
The result may be a one-time event.
Add a limit to the explanation.
This is enough for a useful update.

patterns.t: X grew Y from last year.
patterns.cn: X 比去年增长了 Y。
X 是由 Y 造成的。
这对 X 已经足够。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a 3-sentence update about one number. Use where the number comes from, a one-time event, and add a limit.
